translations.web: Behold, he breaks down, and it can’t be built again. He imprisons a man, and there can be no release.
translations.bsb: What He tears down cannot be rebuilt; the man He imprisons cannot be released.
translations.kjv: Behold, he breaketh down, and it cannot be built again: he shutteth up a man, and there can be no opening.
translations.asv: Behold, he breaketh down, and it cannot be built again; He shutteth up a man, and there can be no opening.
